recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11308; any desired refinement of MolecularDefinition.identifier should be handled as a new MolecularDefinition issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Clinical Genomics request to clarify that Sequence.identifier is a business, universal identifier for the whole Sequence resource, not an ambiguous local identifier for a variation or server-specific instance.
initial_application: Commit 6072b705b61538f2fe3fe5d5cc3779298ae2e79c explicitly referenced #11238 and #11308 and changed source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml so Sequence.identifier's short and definition appended 'This is a FHIR-defined id'. The wording was later carried into MolecularSequence after the Sequence-to-MolecularSequence rename.
additional_context: FHIR-19453 renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence, and FHIR-51227 later superseded legacy MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition. Current fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources, comments out MolecularSequence resource metadata, and keeps MolecularDefinition as the active Clinical Genomics resource. Current source has no Sequence.identifier or MolecularSequence.identifier definition; MolecularDefinition.identifier is a current-model Identifier element and should not receive old DSTU2 Sequence wording without a new Clinical Genomics decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was changed because the historical issue target is retired and there is no current-build Sequence/MolecularSequence identifier source to correct.

related_jiras.note: The same historical source commit also revised Sequence.referenceSeq.strand, but that strand issue has separate semantics and was not decided here.
Published decision renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence after FHIR-11308 had been applied.
Applied decision superseded legacy MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition; the combined branch already contains a separate FHIR-51227 audit commit.
